headline: Radaan Mediaworks files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Radaan Mediaworks concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: Radaan Mediaworks India Limited has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The company also filed the formal voting results with the exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing for the media entity.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
